newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end higher on NCD issues.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end higher on NCD issues.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended higher on Wednesday, driven up by central bank moves to mop up excess liquidity in the banking system, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 5.983 percent against Tuesday's 5.816 close -- pushing farther outside the central bank's 5.0-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper at 6.00 percent against 5.75-6.00.
The central bank had issued NCDs repeatedly in the past week to mop up excessive funds, though it refrained from doing son on Wednesday due to recent rate upswings, dealers said.
Dealers said they expected the rates to ease if there was no further central bank intervention on Thursday as T$8 billion worth of NCDs would be maturing, flushing the market with cash.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 5.9000-9020 percent against 5.9150-9200.
